Name: Bufflehead
Excavator species: Picidae (Colaptes spp., only rarely other species such as Dryocopus pileatus)

Name: Elf Owl
Excavator species: Picidae (Melanerpes formicivorus, M. uropygialis, Colaptes auratus, and C. chrysoides)

Name: Boreal Owl
Excavator species: Picidae (Dryocopus pileatus, Colaptes auratus and Dryocopus martius)

Name: Woodland Kingfisher
Excavator species: Lybiidae, Picidae, Sturnidae and H. albiventris

Name: Rufous-necked Wryneck
Excavator species: Lybiidae (Lybius torquatus and Trachyphonus vaillantii) and Picidae

Name: Collared Falconet
Excavator species: Megalaimidae (Megalaima zeylanica and M. lineata) and Picidae

Name: Thorn-tailed Rayadito
Excavator species: Picidae (Veniliornis lignarius and Colaptes pitus) and Pygarrhychas albogularis

Name: Chilean Swallow
Excavator species: Picidae (Veniliornis lignarius and Campephilus magellanicus) and Pygarrhychas albogularis
